The '''Iridium Quarter''' was an area in [[Xakrea]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]].<ref name="Errant">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref> In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gub Tengo]] lived in an apartment in the Iridium Quarter.<ref name="Errant" />
